# OpenDoors

Upstream: https://github.com/RealDeuce/OpenDoors
Version: 6.3.0
Commit: a02e7e6619c6a575c9957d96a7e2d55f7cb1d2a1

License: LGPL-2.1-or-later (see LICENSE).

This directory contains a source snapshot of OpenDoors,
used by SklaffKOM for native BBS door support.

The source was imported using git archive.
Local build artifacts and Git metadata are excluded.

OpenDoors is maintained independently of SklaffKOM.
